scripts.build: ([ -d dist ] && rm -r dist) ; bun x tsc --project tsconfig.build.json --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist && bun build ./index.ts --outfile ./dist/index.js --target node && bun build ./index.ts --outfile ./dist/index.cjs --format cjs --target node && printf '%s\n' 'import * as injektor from "./index.js";' 'export = injektor;' > ./dist/index.d.cts
scripts.prepare: ( (bun x -p typescript@5.7.3 tsc --project tsconfig.build.json --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --noEmit) || exit 1) && bun run build
scripts.prepublishOnly: ( (bun x -p typescript@5.7.3 tsc --project tsconfig.build.json --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --noEmit) || exit 1) && bun run build
